answers.label: Benefits and challenges of consequential methods
answers.text:
A consequential accounting method for electricity-sector emissions can be beneficial in helping to measure real world market impact if it is mandatory and implementable.

Reporting on additionality should be required for both Scope 2 attributional and consequential accounting, but in a way that is practical and not overly prescriptive. Additionality in attributional and consequential accounting would enhance the legitimacy of the voluntary efforts that have contributed to new clean energy capacity and would further incentivize climate action through clean energy investment.
